d : Do you know it's Amal's birthday today? We __________ give him a surprise party this evening. Come and join us.

: Oh, I'd love to. I'd like to buy something for him. What __________ you __________ give him?

: I've bought some books.

: I __________ buy some music CDs then.

At the beginning of every year Mary makes some resolutions about things she is going to do during the year. This year also Mary writes down her New Year's resolutions in her diary. Complete the sentences with 'm going to plus an appropriate verb form the list of verbs below.

learn          play          spend          study          practise

a    I'm ____________________ for my SSC exam seriously.

b    I'm ______________ to use the computer.

c    I'm ______________ more time with my grandparents.

d    I'm ______________ speaking English regularly.
Think of some resolutions that you'd like to make at the beginning of the next year. Write them down using 'going to'.
